rawContent: #BoycottStarbucks is trending on Twitter.  Lefties all mad because Starbucks won't agree to let their employees wear #BlackLivesMatter shit.  I don't see a problem with that.  They are a private company.
Are we the only country dumb enough to have a civil war because people are offended by the first one?  History is bound to repeat itself. #BlackLivesMatter #WhitePrivilege #CivilWar
